purpose: Append-only withdrawal rules for a current Shine Defence badge on an exact previously reviewed release.
rules: A revocation may target only an exact app commit/profile pair already present in the reviewed ecosystem ledger.
Revocation records are append-only historical facts and are not deleted when a replacement release is certified.
A revoked release cannot make a current Protected by Shine Defence claim.
Restoring a current badge requires a new reviewed release and new certification receipt; it does not erase the revocation.
Public reasons must be concise and must not contain secrets, credentials or exploit instructions.
nonClaims: Revocation does not claim that every version of an application is unsafe.
Revocation is not a substitute for incident response, patching or user notification when those are required.
